mechanics.claim: Braum's basic attacks and Winter's Bite apply a stack; after the first stack, allied champions' basic attacks can also add stacks on-hit.
mechanics.quote: '''Braum's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} and ''{{ai|Winter's Bite|Braum}}'' each apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Concussive Blows'' to their target for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 4 times. Once the first stack has been applied, any allied {{tip|champion|champion's}} basic attack applies an additional stack to the target {{tip|on-hit}}.

mechanics.claim: The 4th stack consumes all stacks to deal magic damage and stun the target.
mechanics.quote: The fourth stack against a target consumes them all to deal {{as|{{pplevel|26 to 196|type=his level|label1=his level}}|magic damage}} {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|stun}} them

mechanics.claim: After triggering, the target cannot receive new stacks for a period, but takes bonus magic damage from Braum's basic attacks during that window.

mechanics.claim: Concussive Blows is not applied if the attack is dodged, blocked, or misses.
mechanics.quote: ''Concussive Blows'' won't be applied if the attack is {{tip|dodge|dodged}} or {{tip|block|blocked}} or if the attack {{tip|blind|misses}}.
